The new file is `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:
```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

I searched the rest of the repo and nothing else uses `emial`, so no application code needed changing. I haven't run the migration.

The exception is the notifier service: `services/notifier/migrations/` hasn't launched, so none of its migrations have been applied anywhere yet. Editing those in place is a different question, but this fix didn't touch them.
